problem: If $\,\text{Re}(x)=[\begin{aligned}a \\ b\end{aligned}]\,$ and $\,\text{Im}(x)=[\begin{aligned}c \\ d\end{aligned}]\,$ are the real and imaginary parts of the vector $\,x=[\begin{aligned}1-3\text{i} \\ -1-5\text{i}\end{aligned}]\,$ then what is the value of $ac+bd?$

feedback.problem: Find the real part of the vector $v=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\text{i}-4\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
For the given vector $\,v=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\text{i}-4\end{aligned}]\,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 7\text{i}-4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3+0\text{i} \\ -4+7\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(v)}+\text{i}\,{{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 7\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(v)}.\end{aligned}
$$
